title: Your First Trade
bigIdea: A market order buys at the current price, right now.

steps.prompt: Ready to make your first move? Nothing real is at risk. When you tap Buy with a market order, when does the trade happen?

options.text: Right away, at about the current price
Only if the price drops first
At the end of the week

steps.reveal: A market order fills right away at roughly the current price. You trade speed for not picking an exact price.

cards.title: What a market order is
cards.body: A market order says: buy now, at whatever the going price is. It is the simplest way to buy a share.

cards.title: What a share count means
cards.body: Buying 3 shares means you own 3 slices. Your cost is roughly 3 times the current price.

cards.title: After you tap Buy
cards.body: The shares land in your paper portfolio. This is practice money only, so you can learn without any real risk.

steps.prompt: In your own words, what did you just get when your buy went through?

options.text: A small ownership stake in that company, held in my paper portfolio
A loan the company now owes me
A guarantee that the price will go up

steps.explanation: A market buy gave you shares, meaning a small ownership stake. It is not a loan and it is never a guarantee of profit.
